thesis: The episode explains that NFTs are non-fungible tokens representing unique digital or physical assets tracked on a blockchain, enabling ownership without third-party intermediaries. It argues that this architecture allows for transparent, automated royalty payments to creators via smart contracts, contrasting this efficiency with the opaque systems found in traditional industries like music.
